capabilities: View Google Calendar events in a sidebar with day, 3-day, and week views
Create and edit events including recurrence, guests, location, and description
Accept, decline, or tentatively respond to invites
Move events by dragging and create events by clicking empty slots
Show or hide calendars across multiple Google accounts
extras: Desktop-only. Users must set up their own Google Cloud project; Google shows an 'app isn't verified' warning during sign-in, which the README explains. OAuth tokens are stored locally in the vault's data.json. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, so users must leave the app to see and manage their Google Calendar events.

relations.evidence: An interactive Google Calendar sidebar for Obsidian. Multiple accounts, bi-directional sync, drag to move, accept/reject invites.

requires.name: Own Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret with Calendar API enabled

summary: Interactive Google Calendar sidebar with multi-account support, bi-directional sync, drag-to-move events, and invite responses.
